thread:
Erin M: Heads-up — need a rapid battlecard refresh for next week's webinar. Focus: where Redwood beats cloud AI platforms + LLM APIs on latency/cost/ops. Short bullets we can hand to sales and the host.
Jonah S: +1. Do we want separate sections: Cloud APIs, API-first LLM vendors, Infra vendors? each with 3 quick callouts and 1 demo hook.
Priya K: yes — and add a one-liner for 'fallback/resilience' and 'model economics'. Sales always asks for exact numbers.
Liam R: For numbers: use internal benchmark from last month: 95th-pct latency 120ms vs cloud 260ms on same 8k prompt; cost per token ~0.5x after batching/kv-caching. I'll pull slides.
Erin M: perfect. Can someone draft 3 soundbites? Need one for the webinar promo tweet and one for the battlecard header.
Kayla T: Drafts —
Kayla T: "Ship predictable LLM inference — same API across hosted, dedicated, and private with production SLAs." 
Kayla T: "Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency: workload-aware batching + KV caching yields up to 2x cost savings vs unmanaged endpoints." 
Kayla T: "When capacity matters, don’t rely on a single cloud: smart routing and model fallbacks keep apps online." 
Jonah S: love the tone. Shorten the second for tweet: "2x cost cuts for real workloads — batching + caching, not guesswork." :thumbsup: 
Priya K: For battlecard sections — suggestion format:
Priya K: ```
- Claim
- Why it matters
- Evidence (benchmark / customer quote)
- Rebuttal to vendor claim
- Sales ask
```
Erin M: yes. Add a quick rebut for 'we're simplest' cloud claim.
Liam R: Rebut: "Simplicity hides tradeoffs — one-size endpoints force latency/cost compromises. We give predictable economics and control for production." Shorten for card: "Simple endpoints today, hidden cost & latency tomorrow. We give predictable economics." 
Jonah S: assign: Kayla — put soundbites in the battlecard doc. Liam — paste benchmark numbers and one chart. Priya — draft the 'rebut' bullets for Cloud, LLM API, Infra vendor. I'll coordinate with AMs for customer quotes.
Kayla T: on it. link to draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/battlecards/ops-snapshots (please make sure perms)
Erin M: timeline — need version 0.1 by EOD Thu so design can mock for Friday's dry run. Can everyone confirm?
All: :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: Reminder set: #marketing to review 2023-11-02 09:00AM PST
Erin M: thanks all — will ping again when we have the slide. Closing thread.
